name: bowser-ui
description: HTML chrome (toolbar, tabs, rail, sidebar, panels, popups) for the Bowser WebView2 chrome host

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node build.mjs && node write-manifest.mjs
scripts.test: node --test test/tabs-reconcile.mjs test/contract.mjs test/hardening.mjs test/rail.mjs test/menu.mjs test/popup-contract.mjs test/panel-history.mjs test/panel-bookmarks.mjs test/panel-customize.mjs test/panel-notes.mjs test/panel-privacy.mjs test/panel-settings.mjs test/panel-kit.mjs test/icons.mjs test/styles.mjs test/hover.mjs && node --test test/sidebar.mjs test/sidebar-contract.mjs
